title: Google Gemini native API integration
changes: Replaced the generic OpenAI-compatible diagnosis proxy with Google's native Gemini generateContent REST API.
Configured gemini-3.8-flash as the default image-capable diagnosis model, with optional GEMINI_MODEL override.
Moved authentication to the server-only GEMINI_API_KEY environment secret using x-goog-api-key.
Added inlineData image transmission, structured JSON response schema, timeout handling, and provider-aware quota/auth errors.
Updated Vercel deployment, cost, privacy, and troubleshooting documentation.
not_enabled_until_configured: Live image diagnosis remains disabled until GEMINI_API_KEY is configured in server environment variables and the project is redeployed.
No live Gemini request or real-plant image inference has been run in this build environment.
